notes:
Version 2.2.0.0 — Commander Brackets

Bracket estimates now follow Game Changer limits and check actual combos through
Commander Spellbook. View the reasons, matched combos, and source information.

Choose a declared bracket separately from the estimate, including Exhibition and
cEDH. The deck editor previews changes as you edit, and “Use estimate” clears your
declaration. Unknown, partial, banned-card, and saved offline results are labeled
clearly. The old power score has been removed.

Includes compatibility with the updated server API and cached older deck data.
